name: Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Settle your upper back against the support, plant both feet on the platform and secure the pad across your hip creases.
Brace your abdomen and press through your feet to drive your hips upward against the pad.
Stop when your hips are extended and your torso lines up with your thighs.
Lower your hips smoothly and settle the machine into its resting position before releasing the pad.
tips: Set your feet so your shins are roughly upright at the top.
Keep your lower ribs down as you finish the lift.
